reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random. The ticket number is #88412. It was the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing during the BOL barcode scan at Tansleigh Packaging.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025, and confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of that channel, so they could have found this themselves.

There's also an email about a different Door 6 problem at Tansleigh, ticket #4912, a "phantom lock" at their Marietta plant. I didn't mention it because Hollis might not be able to see that email, and it isn't the tablet-freezing issue.
